profile.headline: Software Engineer, Game Dev, Film Buff, Ravenclaw
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer with 7+ years in the tech industry. I'm all about embracing the fun side of coding, while mastering new concepts and tools to supercharge my efficiency. I also compete in national video game tournaments and attend movie trivia nights whenever I can.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Sharpening my programming skills learning, practicing and mastering new technologies. I'm currently using C++ and Python, while exploring AI in regards to it's practical and ethical applications.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language), Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +8 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Delivered 12+ scalable microservices in C#, .NET, and Python. Writing reliable, testable, maintainable, and performant code, resulting in a 35% decrease in system downtime across enterprise products
* Led code reviews and design reviews for 20+ feature rollouts, ensuring SDLC best practices
* Automated over 75% of integration tests and deployment scripts, increasing test coverage and shortening release cycles
* Refactored AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Docker, cutting operational costs by $67K/month and optimizing system performance.
* Mentored junior developers on proficient use of C# and TypeScript, ensuring consistency with industry-adopted programming languages across codebases

positions.title: QA Analyst & Dev Support: Paragon, Fortnite, Unreal Tournament
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
* Conducted system integration tests across multiple platforms, identifying 70+ high-impact bugs that improved gameplay stability
* Authored 120+ detailed bug reports and regression scripts, contributing to faster turnaround times for patch releases
* Collaborated directly with devs in code review sessions, prioritizing critical performance issues for resolution
* Maintained documentation for QA processes with an emphasis on reliable and maintainable testing standards

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Morrisville, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
* Built modular UI components and backend APIs in ASP.NET and JavaScript, producing performant code
Refactored data processing modules to be testable and maintainable, reducing reported bugs by 40% over a 6-month span
* Participated in daily stand-ups and code merges, aligning with Agile SDLC
* Designed and implemented integration test suites for legacy systems
